# AWS Architecture Icons

These PNGs are Amazon Web Services' official AWS Architecture Icons, copied
unchanged from AWS's own redistribution of them,
[awslabs/aws-icons-for-plantuml](https://github.com/awslabs/aws-icons-for-plantuml)
(`dist/`, commit `e26e2c0` of 2026-09-01, built from AWS Architecture Icons
release 23.1-2026.04.28). The folders mirror `dist/`.

AWS licenses the icons in that repository under CC BY-ND 2.0 (`LICENSE`): they
may be redistributed unchanged with credit, and never modified. AWS allows
customers and partners to use them to create architecture diagrams
(https://aws.amazon.com/architecture/icons/), which is the only place Archer
draws them.

Don't edit, recolor, crop or trace these files. To update, copy the new files
from a newer awslabs release, then run `pnpm --filter @archer/catalog logos`.

Credit: AWS Architecture Icons © Amazon Web Services, Inc. or its affiliates,
licensed under CC BY-ND 2.0.
